deadline.quote: Submit the Graduate and Professional Admissions Application by December 1, 2026.

gre_general.value: GRE scores are required for all applicants and must be within five years; there is no minimum score.
gre_general.quote: Graduate Record Examination (GRE) scores are required for all applicants and must be from within the past five years.

also.quote: We do not have a minimum GRE score requirement for admission.

fee_waiver.value: Waivers only for applicants with US-funded research experience (any nationality) and some U.S. citizens/permanent residents.
fee_waiver.quote: Fee waivers can be obtained for any applicant who has performed biological or biomedically oriented research that has been supported by the NIH, the NSF, or any other agency/private foundation within the United States.

supervisor.value: An admissions committee selects students; no advisor is needed in advance.
supervisor.quote: The Admissions Committee reviews applications and identifies students who are a good fit for our program.

funding.value: Every PhD offer includes full funding: 12-month stipend, tuition waiver, health insurance and fees.
funding.quote: All PhD admission offers comes with full funding, which includes a 12-month stipend, a full tuition waiver, student health insurance and activity fees.

entry_route.value: Ideal applicants hold a bachelor's degree with calculus, linear algebra and introductory statistics.
entry_route.quote: Ideal applicants hold a bachelor’s degree and have taken three semesters of college calculus (through multivariable calculus), one semester of linear algebra, and a class in introductory statistics.

notes: Biostatistics is the only statistics PhD (School of Medicine, admitted through the Graduate School).
